career_ladder.note: Class-I executive engineering cadre under the Electricity Service Commission (ESC / Vidyut Seva Aayog) of Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) and its affiliated distribution/transmission utilities (UPPTCL, MVVNL, PVVNL, DVVNL, PuVVNL, KESCO). Promotion to higher engineering ranks is governed by UPPCL Engineering Service Regulations based on residency and merit-cum-seniority.

steps.designation: Assistant Engineer (Trainee) / Assistant Engineer (Electrical / Electronics / CS / Civil)
Executive Engineer (EE / Adhishasi Abhiyanta / Divisional Officer)
Superintending Engineer (SE / Adhikshan Abhiyanta / Circle Head)
Chief Engineer (CE / Mukhya Abhiyanta / Zonal Discom Chief)
steps.source_label: UPPCL Board of Directors & Chief Engineer Cadre Regulations
UP State Power Sector Board Governance Rules

exam_scheme.note: Selection process utilizes normalized scores from the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) in the relevant discipline (Electrical, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Science/IT, Civil) followed by Document Verification and Personal Interview conducted by the Electricity Service Commission (ESC).

papers.paper_name: GATE Examination in Relevant Engineering Stream (EE / EC / CS / CE)
papers.negative_marking: Per GATE standard marking scheme (1/3rd negative for MCQs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit cutoff determined by UPPCL ESC based on vacancies

stages.source_label: UPPCL ESC Interview Guidelines & Call Letters

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Technical Assessment, Problem Solving & Viva)

financial_package.note: Assistant Engineers in UPPCL are placed in Pay Level 10 (Entry Basic Pay ₹56,100) under the 7th CPC aligned UPPCL Revised Pay Matrix. Officers receive Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, technical allowance, and concessional power quota.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UPPCL Revised Pay Scales (7th CPC Level 10) & Order No. 658/VSA/2024/AE
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 with 58% DA (₹32,538), HRA (₹6,000 to ₹12,000 depending on Lucknow/Discom headquarters posting), technical allowance, electricity concession, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹8,864) and professional taxes.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP public sector undertakings rules
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or official residential accommodation in power colony
Concessional domestic electricity unit quota per UPPCL corporate policy
Mobile phone call reimbursement and official conveyance allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement for self and dependent family members
